name: OpenSEO
long_description:
Connect to your AI Agent in 2 minutes.

Get expert level advice tailored to your business backed by real data like keyword search traffic, backlinks, and technical audits of your site.

Here are some good skills to start with:

/seo-audit What 1-2 changes to your website will drive more traffic?
/keyword-research Find topics worth writing about?
/competitor-analysis Understand your competitors’ SEO strategy.
one_liner: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
